description: This file defines the SerializerGenerator class responsible for generating serializer classes for types, including methods for serialization/deserialization, handling various member types, and supporting enum and generic types within the Orleans code generation framework.

classes.name: SerializerGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating serializer classes for types, including methods for serialization/deserialization, handling various member types, and supporting enum and generic types within the Orleans code generation framework.

classes.name: GeneratedFieldDescription
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a generated field in the serializer class.

classes.name: BaseCodecFieldDescription
classes.description: Represents a field for the base type serializer, injected or static.

classes.name: ActivatorFieldDescription
classes.description: Represents a field for an activator used to create instances of the type.

classes.name: CodecFieldDescription
classes.description: Represents a field for a codec associated with a member.

classes.name: TypeFieldDescription
classes.description: Represents a field for the type information of a member.

classes.name: CodecFieldTypeFieldDescription
classes.description: Represents a field for the codec type of a member.

classes.name: FieldAccessorDescription
classes.description: Represents a description of a field accessor, including unsafe accessors.

classes.name: SerializationHookFieldDescription
classes.description: Represents a field for serialization hooks.

classes.name: ISerializableMember
classes.description: Interface representing a serializable member (field/property) of a type.

classes.name: SerializableMethodMember
classes.description: Implementation of ISerializableMember for method-based members.

classes.name: SerializableMember
classes.description: Implementation of ISerializableMember for field/property members.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Generates a serializer class syntax for a given type description.

methods.name: GetSimpleClassName
methods.description: Returns a simple class name for the serializer based on the type name.

methods.name: GetGeneratedNamespaceName
methods.description: Returns the namespace for generated serializers based on the type's namespace.

methods.name: GetFieldDeclarations
methods.description: Creates field declarations for the serializer class based on field descriptions.

methods.name: GenerateConstructor
methods.description: Creates a constructor for the serializer class, injecting dependencies.

methods.name: GetFieldDescriptions
methods.description: Collects and creates descriptions for all fields/members to be serialized.

methods.name: GetBaseTypeField
methods.description: Creates a description for the base type serializer field.

methods.name: AddSerializationMembers
methods.description: Adds serialization code for each member.

methods.name: GenerateEnumWriteMethod
methods.description: Creates the method to write enum values.

methods.name: GenerateEnumReadMethod
methods.description: Creates the method to read enum values.

methods.name: GenerateCompoundTypeWriteFieldMethod
methods.description: Creates the method to write a field of a compound type.

methods.name: GenerateCompoundTypeReadValueMethod
methods.description: Creates the method to read a value of a compound type.

methods.name: AddSerializationCallbacks
methods.description: Adds callback invocations for serialization hooks.

methods.name: GetFieldAccessor
methods.description: Creates syntax for unsafe field accessors.
